text: Chapter 2: adding and subtracting! Let's add 2,456 and 1,378. Line up the houses: ones under ones, tens under tens.
Start with the ones: six plus eight is fourteen. Write four and carry one to the tens.
Tens: five plus seven plus the carried one is thirteen. Write three and carry one.
Hundreds: four plus three plus one is eight. Thousands: two plus one is three.
